# `task_batch_commit`

**Commit a proposed task batch.** Turn an approved proposal into real tasks and dependencies.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Capability | `task_batch_commit` |
| Side effect | `composite` |
| Idempotency | keyed on `proposal_id` |
